claims.text: Jasper serves as a good baseline approach for exploring more sophisticated techniques in speech recognition.
Using SGD with momentum, Jasper DR 10x5 achieved a WER of 3.64% on dev-clean LibriSpeech, indicating its effectiveness as a baseline model.
Jasper was evaluated on various datasets, including LibriSpeech and Hub5'00, providing baseline performance metrics for comparison.
